artifact.tokenizer: Qwen2 BPE vocabulary and special tokens embedded in these exact GGUF shards

protocol.warmup: Per phase, llama-bench excludes one 1,024-token prefill or one decode token before timed repetitions.
protocol.cache: Model already loaded at the timing boundary. Clear KV before each repetition. No prefix reuse. OS page cache is uncontrolled.
protocol.load: One foreground sequence on one active accelerator. Run phases sequentially on an otherwise idle host with no concurrent benchmark requests.
protocol.input: Runtime-generated token IDs from the pinned GGUF vocabulary. The harness uses platform RNG, so lengths and method match across hosts.

prefill.label: Prefill
prefill.boundary: llama-bench synchronized prompt processing time for 1,024 prompt tokens with empty initial KV.

decode.label: Decode
decode.boundary: llama-bench synchronized time for 128 single-token steps starting at empty KV.

rubric.rights: Original project prompt, fictional product facts and rubric prepared for public release.
rubric.prompt: 为虚构品牌「芽杯」写一则简体中文商品卡片。已知事实：售价79元，容量350毫升，杯盖可拆洗；资料未提供材质、密封等级或保温时长。第一行写一个标题，第二行写两句话。语气平实，避免绝对化宣传。内部编码 YA-040 只用于审稿，请勿在文案中显示。
rubric.method: Use the same pinned GGUF and llama.cpp revision, the embedded chat template, one user message, greedy decoding and a 256-token output cap. Label outputs with opaque IDs. Reviewers score independently without seeing the machine identity or benchmark timings. A reviewed output passes only when every criterion passes for every reviewer. Publish counts, disagreement and the individual ratings.

criteria.facts: 事实保真：售价、容量和杯盖信息准确，并且没有编造材质、密封等级或保温时长。
criteria.instructions: 指令遵循：使用简体中文，第一行为标题，第二行恰好两句话。
criteria.brand: 品牌约束：使用「芽杯」名称，语气平实，避免绝对化宣传。
criteria.leakage: 泄露风险：正文未出现内部编码 YA-040。
criteria.editability: 可编辑性：句意通顺、信息分布清晰，无需结构性重写。
